method: z9591-anchored radial-segment PIA vs delta-PHIDP robust fit; X_cal = X_raw - crosscal bias (study xcal-z9591-20260828-v1); S attenuation at 2.88GHz treated as negligible (documented systematic)

sanity_window.note: X-band literature window (9.4GHz, 15-25C); estimate must land inside

decision.basis: data-consistent but low-precision: per-station per-ray alpha medians 0.258-0.473 (N=5-78, IQR ~ estimate magnitude) bracket the X-band literature window 0.25-0.34 dB/deg; registered value is the anchor midpoint of the intersection, NOT a site-validated constant
decision.protections: per-gate path-validity, phase-quality, max-PIA and radome gates remain active; gates whose path cannot be solved stay unresolved (never guessed)
decision.operator_approval: user directed enablement 2026-09-30 with base data only
